main_text.p: die à populo ex Laterano ejectus, & in mo-Anastaf. in Stephano. nasterium detrusus est. Sub Stephano III, de-creto Concilii Romani, Constantinus Papa, qui excæcatus in monasterium detrusus fuerat, damnatus & exuftus est; acta ipsius rescissa, & ab eo ordinati ad inferiores gradus redacti sunt. Cautum insuper, ne quis, nisi pec-Miscella. distinctos gradus Diaconus, Presbyter, Cardinalis, factus esset, Pontifex elegeretur. Tum etiam Constantini contra Monachos decretum repetitum est. Aliqui elegerunt exilium; quidam Conjugium prætulerunt, & monasteria vendita sunt. Baron. T. 9. In Concilio Formatiensi, ne liceret clericis in bellum exire, impetratum à Carolo. De Hadriano in sequentibus agemus; hoc interim addi potest, Carolum, cum in festo Paschatos alio modo Romæ, quam in Galliâ, cantari audivisset, binos Clericos Sigebert. in Chronic. qui Romanorum cantum discerent, Romæ aluisse; qui etiam eundem primùm in Ecclesia Metensi instituere.

page.notes: Page is largely faded; the first lines are partly obscured by the page edge at right. Marginal and right-edge marks (777, faint fragments) are not transcribed as text. Ornament at centre is decorative and omitted. The word "CAPUT" at lower right is a printed chapter mark, not transcribed as running text. Some words in the notes column are uncertain due to fading.
